species.name: Loaghtan

evolves.flag_text: once you have passed a Manx lesson

dex.text: Four horns, mouse-brown wool and a relaxed attitude to the island's history. Grazes the cliffs and watches the ferries with polite interest.
dex.fact: Loaghtan is Manx for 'mouse-coloured', after the brown colour of the sheep's wool.

species.real: Manx Loaghtan sheep usually grow four horns, and now and then six, which makes shearing day on the Isle of Man an exercise in careful handling.

dex.text: More horns than a sheep strictly needs, and a calm that suggests they were all earned. Watches the Manx cliffs the way a committee watches a minute.
dex.fact: Ned Maddrell, the last native speaker of Manx, died in 1974, and since then the language has been revived, with a Manx-language primary school.
